name: Drum Bus Punch
description: The kick's band held with a slow attack so its front stays and its body is tight, the snare's band lifted a little where it cracks.

name: Parallel Squash
description: Every band crushed at 6 to 1, fast, and half of it under what came in: the quiet details come up while the hits keep their shape.

name: Vocal Even
description: A vocal held even through its body, its sibilance band quick and firm so the S sounds do not jump out.

name: Air Lift
description: The top band lifted where it already sings, an upward expander at 0.7 to 1: air that rises with the music rather than a fixed shelf.

name: De-Harsh Top
description: Only the top and the upper middle turned down when they get sharp, quickly, and let go as quickly: cymbals and a bright voice softened only when they bite.

name: Gentle Master Glue
description: A light hold on every band of a master, a dB or two each at 1.5 to 1 with slow times, so the parts move together without anyone hearing a compressor.

name: Loud Master Bands
description: Every band held harder, at 2.5 to 1, the lows slow and the highs quick, with a little gain back: a dense, even master before the limiter.

name: Tame the Lows
description: The low end held steady under the rest: the bottom band at 3 to 1 with a slow attack so a kick's front gets through, the others left alone.
